abstract: Histochemical investigation of Al-p, HSAP, Ac-p, and LDH was performed with tissues of normal chorionic villi, H. mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma with the following conclusions: 1. In the normal villous tissues, Al-p, HSAP, and Ac-p are localized in syncytiotrophoblast, the former two in the rim of the cell, and the latter inside the cytoplasm. LDH displayed higher activity in cytotrophoblast than syncytiotrophoblast, especially in the former of cell column of initial chorionic villi. 2. In H. mole, Al-p, HSAP, and Ac-p are localized in syncytiotrophoblast of cystic epithelium, and in this layer and transitional cells of the chrioblastic part, the former two are localized in the rim of the cell, the latter within the cytoplasm. LDH is localized in cytotrophoblast and the transitional cell of the cystic epithelium and the chorioblastosis. 3. Localization and activities of Al-p, HSAP, Ac-p, and LDH in invasive mole are closely similar to those in H. mole. 4. Localization and activities of Al-p, HSAP, and Ac-p in choriocarcinoma presented various aspects, but more frequently they are localized in syncytiotrophoblasts in the periphery of focus and also partly in cytotrophoblasts and transitional cells. Also localization and activity of LDH showed diversity. However, the activity is stronger in cytotrophoblast. 5. From those findings, choriocarcinoma is hardly comparable with H. mole or invasive mole from an enzymohistochemical viewpoint and is assumed to have specific enzymic deviation invisible in the others and therefore to possess particular characteristics different from those of any other villous tissues.
abstract_ja: 正常絨毛組織、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌を対象に、Al-p、HSAP、Ac-p、LDHの組織化学的検討を行い、以下の結論を得た。1. 正常絨毛組織では、Al-p、HSAPおよびAc-pは合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在し、前二者は細胞の辺縁部に、Ac-pは細胞質内に認められた。LDHは合胞体栄養膜細胞よりも細胞性栄養膜細胞で高い活性を示し、特に初期絨毛の細胞柱の細胞性栄養膜細胞で顕著であった。2. 胞状奇胎では、Al-p、HSAPおよびAc-pは嚢胞上皮の合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在し、この層および絨毛膜芽様部の移行細胞において、前二者は細胞辺縁部、後者は細胞質内に局在した。LDHは嚢胞上皮の細胞性栄養膜細胞および移行細胞、ならびに絨毛膜芽腫性部に局在した。3. 侵入奇胎におけるAl-p、HSAP、Ac-pおよびLDHの局在と活性は、胞状奇胎とほぼ同様であった。4. 妊娠性絨毛癌におけるAl-p、HSAP、Ac-pの局在と活性は多様な像を示したが、病巣周辺部の合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在することが多く、一部では細胞性栄養膜細胞や移行細胞にも認められた。LDHの局在と活性も多様であったが、細胞性栄養膜細胞でより強い活性を示した。5. これらの所見から、妊娠性絨毛癌は酵素組織化学的観点から胞状奇胎や侵入奇胎とはほとんど比較できず、他の絨毛組織には見られない特異的な酵素学的偏倚を有し、他の絨毛組織とは異なる特徴を持つと考えられる。
